iss.source_label: VERIFIED NASA PSI EXPERIMENTAL DATA - 2,051 rows from 19 files
iss.provenance_note: Every row is parsed from files downloaded from psi.nasa.gov (see source_files). Units are converted only where the file itself states the unit (see /api/conversions); quantities a file does not state are NULL. gravity_g (actual gravity) = 0.0 is a project-level ISS / Cygnus flight baseline (gravity_inferred=true; gravity_source says whether the PSI JSON names ISS/Cygnus/MSG/CIR or the value is user-stated) and never tabulated; row-level ground tags would set 1.0. effective_gravity_g is a HEURISTIC PROXY (flow-equivalent), never measured partial gravity (see /api/effective-gravity). Empirical predictors are exposed only if they beat dummy baselines under group cross-validation (/api/model-audit); otherwise the nearest real experimental tests are returned. Research triage, not a certified determination.
iss.gravity_note: sim_gravity_actual = match of the ACTUAL gravity_g (0.0 g ISS/Cygnus flight baseline unless a row is ground-tagged); sim_gravity_proxy = 0.25-weighted match of the HEURISTIC effective-gravity proxy (forced flow -> equivalent g), counted only for rows with BOTH O2 and pressure recorded; gravity_basis says which one set sim_gravity. A proxy match is never measured partial-gravity data. Missing O2 / pressure scores sim_po2 / sim_pressure = 0.15 (not neutral 0.5).
